Synopsis:
    Gold is steady near $4,469/oz ahead of the August US nonfarm payrolls release, which will be a key input for the Fed's September rate decision. A 50% probability of a rate hike is priced in. Fed Governor Waller signaled openness to a pause if inflation continues moderating, which triggered a 2% gold rally Thursday. Upcoming inflation data next week adds further uncertainty. Geopolitical tension between the US and Iran (now in its seventh month) provides a soft safe-haven floor. Silver, platinum, and palladium are modestly lower on the week.
